# VoiceClone (myvoiceclones.com)

> Offline voice cloning for Windows, paid for once. You clone your own voice on your own PC, type a
> script, and get a voiceover back with every word checked so you can click and fix any that came
> out wrong. Nothing is uploaded, there is no subscription, and the cloned voice stays on the
> machine and keeps working. Built by Inam Ul Haq, an automation engineer who also builds tools at
> designesh.com.

## How it is different from cloud voice tools
- The voice model is compiled and kept locally, so it does not stop working when a subscription lapses
- No audio leaves the computer, which is the difference that matters for a private or client voice
- Paid for once, with no per character or per minute charge
- Works with no internet connection at all
- The trade off, stated honestly: a local model needs a decent Windows PC, and the large cloud
  services still offer more ready made voices and more languages

## Who made it
Inam Ul Haq. Automation and data engineer, and a transmission planning engineer by trade. He builds
and ships his own Windows tools, listed at [designesh.com](https://designesh.com/products).

## Good reasons to use it
- You narrate videos regularly and do not want a per minute bill
- The voice is yours or your client's and must not be uploaded anywhere
- You work somewhere with poor or no internet
- You want the same voice to still work in a year without renewing anything
